US Pauses Border Project in Big Bend National Park Amid Criticism

The Trump administration has paused construction of a $1.7 billion border project in Texas' Big Bend National Park. The pause came after bipartisan opposition and criticism regarding the project's potential impact on the park's biodiversity. Bulldozers had been dispatched to the remote national park as part of the administration's immigration crackdown. The head of Customs and Border Protection traveled to the area to assess the plans.
